_meanings:
(<ab>Ved.</ab>) To be worshipped by offering sacrifices
 (<ls>Sāy.</ls> {#aBiyazwavya#}); an assistant, a protector, one who is praised
 or worshipped as a protector, one who approaches to assist or attack,
 one who assails or overpowers an enemy, one who approaches in order to
 obtain, desiring, desire (these meanings are given by European scholars).

Assistance, help, worshipping, praising; a sacrifice;
 a hymn; approaching to assist or approaching in general; access.
